description:
Hi everyone! We are Team Vision, participating in the Trivandrum local event for the "Be An Earth System Trend Detective!" challenge. We are passionate about space exploration, human exploration, and the Moon, and we're excited to uncover meaningful Earth system insights using NASA data.

We are looking for motivated teammates—especially those skilled in data analysis, coding, Earth science, or storytelling—who love problem-solving and want to build an impactful project together. Join us!
